reviews.title: Absolutely phenomenal if you’re upgrading your PC
reviews.comment: A friend recommended this to me, I’m new to the PC world and built my first one but I had no graphics card at all. And when I bought this and installed it. I got SO MANY FRAMES! I’m pushing 145+ on the games I like to play or consistently having 60+ frames. My specs are: Ryzen 5 5600 GT (CPU) 32GB RAM and MSI Micro Motherboard (can’t remember what it is exactly rn). Though! My experience is from having NO graphics card to getting one. I would say shop around and speak to experts if you’re looking to upgrade your graphics. I also included a picture! I’m sorry it’s messy. Idk how to cable mange.

reviews.title: Horrible crashing (BSOD)
reviews.comment: This gpu has made my computer crash multiple times throughout these past few months, it happens every 3-30 minutes, It’s unbelievable how horrendous my experience has been with this graphics card. And to top it all off, it all started after the refund date was over so I couldn’t fill out an RMA form.
reviews.author: Juan Rivera

reviews.title: Good performance value with quirks
reviews.comment: Currently there is no better performance/price value GPU on the market, and it doesn't use much power either. However, this GPU makes my computer boot up slower, though I have an older X79 board with Ivy Bridge i7-3770k. If I replace this GPU with my old 1050Ti, it boots much faster, but obviously with much worse graphics, so it's a trade-off I can live with.
reviews.author: Miles Raymond

reviews.title: Great mid tier gaming gpu
reviews.comment: I had this card for a while before I upgraded to a better one. It was able to run any game I threw at it although with some you had to reduce some graphics settings. Overall great value card, pretty fast and played games decently well. Good for a mid tier gaming PC.
reviews.author: Shawn
